steps.js: (async () => { const inv = async (m, ...a) => { const r = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw(m, ...a); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message); return r.value; }; const projects = __REPO_PATH__ + '-projects'; const add = await inv('repos.watchedFolders.add', projects); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const result = await inv('repos.scanWatchedFolders'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const repos = await inv('repos.list'); const paths = repos.map((r) => r.path).sort(); return JSON.stringify({ addOk: add.ok, addedTotal: repos.length, rescanAdded: result.added, cancelled: result.cancelled, foundA: paths.includes(projects + __SEP__ + 'a'), foundB: paths.includes(projects + __SEP__ + 'org' + __SEP__ + 'b'), foundDecoy: paths.some((p) => p.indexOf('node_modules') !== -1), total: repos.length, allWatched: repos.every((r) => r.origin === 'watched'), folderProblem: result.folders[0].problem }); })()

(async () => { const inv = async (m, ...a) => { const r = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw(m, ...a); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message); return r.value; }; const projects = __REPO_PATH__ + '-projects'; const dup = await inv('repos.watchedFolders.add', projects); const nested = await inv('repos.watchedFolders.add', projects + __SEP__ + 'org'); return JSON.stringify({ duplicateRejected: dup.ok === false, duplicateMessage: dup.error || '', nestedRejected: nested.ok === false, nestedNamesCovering: (nested.error || '').indexOf(projects) !== -1 }); })()

(async () => { const inv = async (m, ...a) => { const r = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw(m, ...a); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message); return r.value; }; const projects = __REPO_PATH__ + '-projects'; const repos = await inv('repos.list'); const a = repos.find((r) => r.path === projects + __SEP__ + 'a'); await window.__gitgood.actions.removeRepository(a, false); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const excluded = await inv('repos.exclusions.list'); const again = await inv('repos.scanWatchedFolders'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const after = await inv('repos.list'); return JSON.stringify({ excludedCount: excluded.length, addedOnRescan: again.added, stillGone: !after.some((r) => r.path === projects + __SEP__ + 'a'), skipped: again.skipped }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.closeAllDialogs(); window.__gitgood.actions.openDialog({ kind: 'settings', tab: 'git' }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const text = document.body.innerText.toLowerCase(); return JSON.stringify({ hasSection: text.indexOf('watched folders') !== -1, hasExclusionSection: text.indexOf('not added again') !== -1, showsDepth: text.indexOf('depth') !== -1 }); })()

(async () => { const inv = async (m, ...a) => { const r = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw(m, ...a); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message); return r.value; }; const projects = __REPO_PATH__ + '-projects'; window.__gitgood.actions.closeAllDialogs(); const left = await inv('repos.exclusions.remove', projects + __SEP__ + 'a'); const rescan = await inv('repos.scanWatchedFolders'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const after = await inv('repos.list'); return JSON.stringify({ remaining: left.length, addedBack: rescan.added, hasA: after.some((r) => r.path === projects + __SEP__ + 'a') }); })()

(async () => { const inv = async (m, ...a) => { const r = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw(m, ...a); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message); return r.value; }; const projects = __REPO_PATH__ + '-projects'; const result = await inv('repos.scanWatchedFolders'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const after = await inv('repos.list'); const excluded = await inv('repos.exclusions.list'); return JSON.stringify({ dropped: result.dropped, stillListed: after.some((r) => r.path === projects + __SEP__ + 'org' + __SEP__ + 'b'), excludedAfterDrop: excluded.length, summary: window.__gitgood.actions.describeScanResult(result) }); })()
